title: 第21章 金色印记第22章 修炼武技
content_zh:
在混沌塔一层的张皓旸，已经获得青龙锻体术炼体功法、白虎杀伐六叠剑至高剑术、朱雀六变轻身术以及一本玄武丹经。
共获得三本功法和一本养气、炼丹的术法，这让张皓旸无比激动，这已经远超预期。
张皓旸之前预料在混沌塔一层也就能获得一门功法，不料现在收获竟是如此丰厚，他如何能不激动兴奋？
张皓旸将青龙锻体术、白虎杀伐六叠剑、朱雀六变以及玄武丹经收入怀中后，他转身就向混沌塔一层大门走去，就在转身时他突然看到四根金色石柱中间那个由四根金色石柱的底部发出的金色光束在中间位置联通形成的散发着耀眼光芒的金色光球。
混沌塔一层的四根金色石柱就让他有如此巨大的收获，那四根金色石柱中间位置的金色光球内又会有什么功法呢？张皓旸好奇的喃喃自语道。
那四根金色石柱的内部空间代表四大神兽的神殿，中间位置的金色光球又代表什么？金色光球会给他带来什么惊喜呢？张皓旸无比渴望。
张皓旸先是从四周仔细打量一番金色光球，四根金色石柱底部发出的金色光束在中央位置汇集形成金色光球，金色光球内部似有东西悬浮其中。
张皓旸走近金色光球，仔细观察光球中间的悬浮物，光球中似有雾气，他无法看的清楚，只能模糊的看到那个悬浮物有成人手掌大小，呈金色。
张皓旸由外形和大小推测光球中间的悬浮物应该是令牌或者类似物品，因为无法取出，他无法确认。
张皓旸围着金色光球旋转几周，依旧没有找到取出令牌样物品的方法。
于是他心一横，心想就按照在四大神兽神殿获得功法的方法试一下看看能否取出这令牌样物品？
只见他口中默念混沌造化诀，右手就伸向金色光球。
当手碰触金色光球的那一刻，他的手就如同碰到燃烧的火焰般，只听他口中发出“啊”
一声就迅速将右手收回。
张皓旸不停甩动右手以此来减轻右手的灼烧之痛，他拿起右手查看情况，右手上并没有任何红、肿的情况，他无比诧异。
光球那是由四根金色石柱发出的光束凝集而成，他之前在围着金色光球查看时已经碰触过金色光束，他知道金色光束并没有任何热量，那为什么金色光束凝聚而成的金色光球用手触碰却有灼烧之感，另外奇怪的是，被灼烧的手却没有任何外伤？这让张皓旸极为惊讶！
只是更为诧异的还在后面，张皓旸看见右手没有外伤准备再次查看一下金色光球时，他发现原本发出金色光芒的金色光球竟是不再发出光芒，巨大金色球体中的悬浮物体竟是自球体内部缓缓上升直接出现在金色球体表面。
张皓旸看到悬浮物体竟然出现在金色球体表面，他仔细看去，那悬浮物体确实是一枚令牌。
令牌手掌大小，通体金色，在令牌上雕刻一个威严霸气的龙头，但仅看龙头就知他是龙中王者的存在，龙目圆睁，睥睨天下的气势尽出。
张皓旸伸手将令牌拿起，他正想拿到近前仔细查看，未曾想到，那块金色令牌在入手后竟是直接消失不见。

张皓旸大惊赶忙仔细查看，却是发现在手腕内侧出现一个指甲盖大小的方形印记，将右手举到眼前仔细端详，那个印记竟然就是那块金色令牌所化，刚才还手掌大小的金色令牌现如今已经缩小成指甲盖大小并直接出现在他的手腕内侧位置，印记成金黄之色，与四周皮肤略有不同。
张皓旸有些担心，他赶忙查看身体看看有否异常？一番查探之下发现身体并未有什么不舒服、不妥之感，这个印记只是简单的出现在腕部皮肤之上，并没有进入体内，这让他紧张的心情有些放松。
但是即便如此有这么一个印记平白无故的出现自己手上，长在皮肤之上，这让谁都会无比担心。
张皓旸尝试用另一只手去摸金色印记但是根本感觉不到这印记的存在；他用力去抠金色印记，金色印记没有任何变化。
这让张皓旸一时竟有些手足无措，不知该怎么处理这个金色印记！
张皓旸站在金色光球看着右手的金色印记出神，他在思考如何处理这金色印记？
就在此时那原本不再释放光芒的金色光球竟再次发生变化，先是金色光球逐渐暗淡，片刻时间之后，那金色光球直接变成暗灰之色，随即就直接发出“轰隆”
一声巨响就消失不见。
听到巨大的响声，张皓旸心头一震，他仔细看向金色光球位置。
只是变化并未停止，在金色光球变成暗灰之色突然发出巨响消失后，那原本由四根金色石柱发出的四道金色光束也是缓缓消失，最后也消失不见。
变化远不止如此，异变依然在进行，四道金色光束消失后，那原本发出金色光芒的金色石柱竟也在发生变化。
先是东方向的青龙金色石柱上的金色光芒缓缓消失，随即就是青龙金色石柱变成暗灰之色，最后发出“轰隆”
一声巨响后直接消失当场。
紧接着西方向的白虎金色石柱上的金色光芒同样缓缓消失，随即同样是金色石柱变成暗灰之色，最后发出“轰隆”
一声巨响后直接消失当场。
接下来就是朱雀金色石柱与玄武金色石柱在发出“轰隆”
一声巨响后也是直接消失不见。
说来话长，实际从一开始青龙金色石柱消失到玄武金色石柱消失也就十数息时间，现在整个房间之内只剩下张皓旸自己，哪还有四个巨大金色石柱和金色光球的存在？好像四个巨大金色石柱与金色光球之前从没有在此出现过一样！
张皓旸呆立当场不知如何是好？对于眼前突如其来的变化他有些不知所措！
他无法推测发生异变的原因，他能想到的是，四大金色石柱和金色圆球消失，那之前获得的功法会不会也消失了，他赶忙将手伸进怀里，发现青龙锻体术、白虎杀伐六叠剑、朱雀六变身法以及玄武丹经都在，他又向右手手腕处看去，那金色印记也在，他长吁一口气，这才放下心来！

content_en:
Zhang Haoyang, who is on the first floor of the Chaos Tower, has already obtained the Qinglong body-building technique, the White Tiger killing six-fold sword supreme sword technique, the Suzaku six-transformation light-body technique, and a Xuanwu Dan Sutra.
Zhang Haoyang was extremely excited to obtain a total of three exercises and one for nourishing qi and refining elixirs. This was far beyond his expectations.
Zhang Haoyang had expected to obtain a skill on the first floor of the Chaos Tower, but unexpectedly, the harvest was so rich. How could he not be excited?
After Zhang Haoyang took the Azure Dragon Body Forging Technique, the White Tiger Killing Six-fold Sword, the Six Transformations of the Suzaku, and the Xuanwu Alchemy Sutra into his arms, he turned around and walked towards the gate on the first floor of the Chaos Tower. As he turned around, he suddenly saw the golden light ball in the middle of the four golden stone pillars. The golden light beams emitted from the bottoms of the four golden stone pillars were connected in the middle to form a dazzling golden ball of light.
The four golden stone pillars on the first floor of the Chaos Tower gave him such a huge harvest, so what kind of skills can be found in the golden light ball in the middle of the four golden stone pillars? Zhang Haoyang murmured curiously.
The inner spaces of the four golden stone pillars represent the temples of the four sacred beasts. What does the golden ball of light in the middle represent? What surprise will the golden ball of light bring him? Zhang Haoyang is extremely eager.
Zhang Haoyang first carefully looked at the golden ball of light from all around. The golden light beams emitted from the bottom of the four golden stone pillars converged in the center to form a golden ball of light. There seemed to be something suspended inside the golden ball of light.
Zhang Haoyang approached the golden light ball and carefully observed the suspended object in the middle of the light ball. There seemed to be mist in the light ball. He could not see clearly. He could only vaguely see that the suspended object was the size of an adult's palm and was golden in color.
Zhang Haoyang speculated from the shape and size that the suspended object in the middle of the light ball should be a token or similar item. Since it could not be taken out, he could not confirm it.
Zhang Haoyang rotated around the golden ball of light for several weeks, but still couldn't find a way to take out the token-like item.
So he was heartbroken and thought that he would try the method of obtaining the skills in the temple of the four sacred beasts to see if he could get out this token-like item?
I saw him silently reciting the Chaos Creation Technique, and stretched his right hand towards the golden ball of light.
The moment his hand touched the golden ball of light, it was like touching a burning flame, and he could only hear "Ah" coming out of his mouth.
With one sound, he quickly retracted his right hand.
Zhang Haoyang kept shaking his right hand to relieve the burning pain in his right hand. He picked up his right hand to check the situation and found that there was no redness or swelling on his right hand. He was extremely surprised.
The light ball was formed by the condensed light beams emitted by four golden stone pillars. He had touched the golden light beam before when he was looking around the golden light ball. He knew that the golden light beam did not have any heat, so why did the golden light ball condensed by the golden light beam feel burning when touched with the hand? What was also strange was that there was no external injury on the burned hand? This surprised Zhang Haoyang!
But what was even more surprising was what happened later. When Zhang Haoyang saw that there was no trauma on his right hand and was about to check the golden ball of light again, he found that the golden ball of light that originally emitted golden light no longer emitted light. The suspended objects in the huge golden sphere actually slowly rose from the inside of the sphere and appeared directly on the surface of the golden sphere.
Zhang Haoyang saw the suspended object appear on the surface of the golden sphere. He looked carefully and found that the suspended object was indeed a token.
The token is the size of the palm of your hand and is entirely golden. A majestic and domineering dragon head is carved on the token. But just by looking at the dragon head, you can tell that he is the king of dragons. The dragon's eyes are wide open, showing his aura of looking down at the world.
Zhang Haoyang reached out and picked up the token. He was about to take it closer and check it carefully. He never thought that the golden token disappeared immediately after he picked it up.
Zhang Haoyang was shocked and hurriedly took a closer look, but found a square mark the size of a fingernail on the inside of his wrist. He raised his right hand to his eyes and looked carefully. The mark turned out to be the golden token. The golden token that was the size of a palm just now has now shrunk.It was about the size of a fingernail and appeared directly on the inside of his wrist. The mark was golden and slightly different from the surrounding skin.
Zhang Haoyang was a little worried. He hurriedly checked his body to see if there was anything abnormal? After some inspection, he found that there was no discomfort or inappropriate feeling in his body. The mark simply appeared on the skin of his wrist and did not enter his body, which made him feel a little relieved.
But even so, having such a mark appear on his hand and on his skin for no apparent reason would make anyone extremely worried.
Zhang Haoyang tried to touch the golden mark with his other hand, but he couldn't feel the mark at all. He tried to pick at the golden mark, but there was no change in the golden mark.
This left Zhang Haoyang at a loss as to what to do with this golden mark!
Zhang Haoyang stood in the golden light ball and looked at the golden mark on his right hand in trance. He was thinking about how to deal with this golden mark?
At this moment, the golden ball of light that was no longer emitting light actually changed again. First, the golden ball of light gradually dimmed. After a while, the golden ball of light directly turned into a dark gray color, and then directly emitted a "boom"
It disappeared with a loud bang.
Hearing the huge noise, Zhang Haoyang was shocked, and he looked carefully at the location of the golden ball of light.
But the change did not stop. After the golden ball of light turned into dark gray and suddenly disappeared with a loud noise, the four golden beams originally emitted by the four golden stone pillars also slowly disappeared, and finally disappeared.
The changes were far more than that, the mutation was still going on. After the four golden beams disappeared, the golden stone pillars that originally emitted golden light were also changing.
First, the golden light on the Qinglong golden stone pillar in the east slowly disappeared, and then the Qinglong golden stone pillar turned into a dark gray color, and finally let out a "boom"
After a loud noise, he disappeared immediately.
Immediately afterwards, the golden light on the white tiger golden stone pillar in the west also slowly disappeared, and then the same golden stone pillar turned into a dark gray color, and finally let out a "boom"
After a loud noise, he disappeared immediately.
Next, the Suzaku golden stone pillars and the Xuanwu golden stone pillars were making "rumbling" sounds.
After a loud noise, it disappeared directly.
It’s a long story. In fact, it only took ten breaths from the beginning of the Qinglong golden stone pillar to the disappearance of the Xuanwu golden stone pillar. Now Zhang Haoyang is the only one left in the whole room. How can there be four huge golden stone pillars and golden light balls? It was as if the four huge golden stone pillars and golden balls of light had never appeared here before!
Zhang Haoyang stood stunned on the spot, not knowing what to do? He was a little overwhelmed by the sudden changes in front of him!
He couldn't speculate on the cause of the change. What he could think of was that if the four golden stone pillars and golden balls disappeared, then the skills he had acquired before would also disappear. He quickly put his hands into his arms and found that the Qinglong Body Training Technique, the White Tiger Killing Six-fold Sword, the Suzaku Six Transformations Technique, and the Xuanwu Dan Sutra were all there. He looked at his right wrist again and saw that the golden mark was also there. He took a long breath and felt relieved!
